answer:
Yes, AMD reported customer concentration in its FY 2022 10-K. 

In Note 4 (Segment Reporting) and Note 10 (Concentrations of Credit Risk) of the Financial Statements, as well as Item 1 (Business), AMD disclosed that one major customer accounted for 16% of its consolidated net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2022 (consisting of sales from the Gaming segment). Additionally, one customer accounted for approximately 18% of the total consolidated accounts receivable balance as of December 31, 2022.
rationale: AMD reported both revenue concentration (16% of net revenue from a major customer in the Gaming segment) and credit risk/accounts receivable concentration (18% from one customer) in its FY22 10-K.

One customer accounted for approximately 18% of the total consolidated accounts receivable balance as of December 31, 2022.
